name: Honoka ni Mieru Zetsubou no Memento ~Remember that I Love You.~
original_name: 仄かに視える絶望のmemento～Remember that I love you.～
source:
Reality disappears, but past remains.

Main heroines are two girls who have special memory disorder due to some accident. Every few hours there is such time for them that they can't remember afterwards. Memory works in that way that they can't remember anything during that time. In other words, whatever they do during that time, they forget. Knowing this, they work together to compensate for each other's lack of memory. 

In the early stages the story is full of gaps, and the whole picture is not perceived. Protagonists continue to suffer from insidious bullying without understanding how they got into this or that situation. However, as game progresses, different viewpoints are given, and "memories" start to gather together. The whole picture becomes clear.

What kind of ending will the hidden "memories" bring?

[Translated from [url=http://www.digianime.co.jp/soft/me_story.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
现实会消失，但过去仍然存在。

两位女主角因某起事故患上特殊的记忆障碍。每隔几小时，她们便会进入一段之后无法回忆的时间。也就是说，无论在那段时间里做了什么，她们事后都不会记得。知晓这一点后，两人开始合作，互相弥补彼此的记忆缺失。

故事初期充满断片，读者无法看清全貌。主人公们在不明白自己为何陷入某种处境的情况下，持续遭受隐秘的欺凌。然而，随着故事推进，游戏会提供不同视角，“记忆”开始逐渐汇聚，真相也随之清晰。

隐藏的“记忆”会带来怎样的结局？

[译自[url=http://www.digianime.co.jp/soft/me_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
